continuous.observer: Every rendered frame; actual camera frustum versus requested nonempty-or-unknown 3D volumes. Conservative until sampled/baked. Not a pixel visibility/occlusion test.

profile.note: Counts are candidate cells until sampled or baked empty. Optional profiling has overhead. Upload is bounded to 16,384 instances per call; only complete cells become visible.

timing_note: stream_tick measures the whole tick, including refresh/sorting/upload; old HUD last_build_ms excluded refresh. Optional instrumentation is enabled in online/baked runs.
trajectory: 360m camera at 18m/s, 90/180-degree turns; NOT a vehicle physics test
